name: Ayakami Shizume ~Shoujo no Ketsudan, Miko no Ketsui~
original_name: 妖神鎮め ～少女の決断、御子の決意～
source:
Midori spots her boyfriend with another woman at the station and follows them to the mountain where she gets lost. Unable to find her partner or the way back, she witnesses an unbelievable scene.

A strange humanoid figure is fighting a lizard monster that is much larger than a normal animal. The unfamiliar person wins, and Midori shuts her eyes tight, thinking that she is going to become the next target. But when she looks in front of her again, she sees a naked woman, the same one that was with her boyfriend earlier.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=851045]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
绿在车站发现她的男朋友和另一名女子在一起，并跟踪他们到山上，但她迷路了。由于找不到伴侣或回去的路，她目睹了令人难以置信的一幕。

一个奇怪的人形人物正在与一只比普通动物大得多的蜥蜴怪物战斗。陌生的人获胜，绿紧紧闭上眼睛，认为她将成为下一个目标。但当她再次看向前方时，却看到了一个赤身裸体的女人，正是刚才和男友在一起的那个女人。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=851045]Getchu[/url]]
